source: NCBI protein EFetch, accession-specific FASTA sequences

specific_biochemical_justification.reason: Arabidopsis BANYULS/ANR is a short-chain reductase homolog of DFR but catalyzes anthocyanidin reduction; see PMID 12532018 and NCBI BAN gene 842469.
Arabidopsis FLS1 shares the 2-oxoglutarate/Fe(II)-dependent oxygenase enzyme superfamily with ANS/LDOX, but catalyzes flavonol rather than anthocyanidin synthesis.

role: Sensitivity screen that prevents the original DFR/ANS one-reference nearest-match analysis from being automatically treated as pigment-enzyme orthology
source_paper_study: Park et al 2020 Cirsium japonicum source transcriptome (2020), not 2026 Ryukyu source libraries
critical_limitation: Sequence nearest reference and local homology cannot alone distinguish enzyme substrate, isoforms, paralogs, cytotype or causal flower re-expression

references.biology_evidence: Public annotated protein; family label is a reference, not proven Cirsium enzyme activity
